from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly.invoice import invoice_total, issue_invoice
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem, Subscription
from ledgerly.payments import authorize
from ledgerly.subscriptions import current_period

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def make_invoice():
    return Invoice(
        id="inv_1",
        customer_id="cus_1",
        lines=[LineItem("Seat", 3, Decimal("19.99")), LineItem("Setup", 1, Decimal("50.00"))],
    )


def test_invoice_total():

    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    assert inv.status == "issued"
    assert audit.events("invoice_issued")[0]["invoice_id"] == "inv_1"


def test_issue_empty_invoice_fails():
    with pytest.raises(BillingError):
        issue_invoice(Invoice(id="inv_2", customer_id="cus_1"), T0)


def test_authorize_payment():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    payment = authorize("pay_1", inv, "109.97", T0)
    assert payment.amount == Decimal("109.97")
    assert payment.status == "authorized"


def test_current_period():
    sub = Subscription("sub_1", "cus_1", Decimal("30.00"), 30, T0)

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, LineItem
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money


def line_total(line: LineItem) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(to_money(line.unit_price) * line.quantity)


def invoice_total(invoice: Invoice) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(sum((line_total(line) for line in invoice.lines), ZERO))


def issue_invoice(invoice: Invoice, at: datetime) -> Invoice:
    if invoice.status != "draft":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    if not invoice.lines:
        raise BillingError("empty_invoice", invoice.id)
    invoice.issued_at = ensure_utc(at)
    invoice.status = "issued"
    audit.record("invoice_issued", invoice_id=invoice.id, total=invoice_total(invoice))
    return invoice

"""Promotion campaigns (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from datetime import datetime

CAMPAIGNS = {"black-friday": {"percent": 30, "ends": datetime(2025, 12, 1)}}


def campaign_percent(name: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> int:
    campaign = CAMPAIGNS.get(name)
    if campaign is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown campaign {name!r}")
    now = now or datetime.now()
    return campaign["percent"] if now < campaign["ends"] else 0


def bulk_discount_percent(quantity: int) -> int:
    if quantity < 0:
        raise ValueError("quantity must be non-negative")
    if quantity >= 50:
        return 10
    return 5 if quantity >= 10 else 0

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Subscription


def current_period(sub: Subscription, at: datetime) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """Return the [start, end) billing period of ``sub`` that contains ``at``."""
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    if at < start:
        raise BillingError("before_start", at.isoformat())
    length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    n = (at - start) // length
    period_start = start + n * length
    return period_start, period_start + length

"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money

# Finance policy FIN-2026-03: support-initiated refunds above this amount need
# a second approver.
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00")


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def _find_idempotent_result(idempotency_key):
    """Return the audit entry recorded for ``idempotency_key``, if any."""
    if idempotency_key is None:
        return None
    for entry in audit.events():
        if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
            return entry
    return None


def refund(payment, amount, at, *, idempotency_key=None, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment.

    ``idempotency_key`` makes the operation safe to retry: a repeated call with
    the same key returns the original payment without applying the refund
    again. Refunds above ``APPROVAL_THRESHOLD`` require ``approved_by``.
    """
    # Idempotency is checked first, before any state validation, so retries of
    # an already-applied refund succeed even though the payment state changed.
    if _find_idempotent_result(idempotency_key) is not None:
        return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and not approved_by:
        raise BillingError(
            "approval_required",
            f"refund of {amount} requires a second approver",
        )
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount or ZERO)
    if refunded + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"refund of {amount} would exceed captured amount {payment.amount}",
        )
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        at=at,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        approved_by=approved_by,
    )
    return payment
EOF

{"command": "cd /tmp/attest_workspaces/runs__demo__learn__E04/workspace && python - <<'EOF'
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

def mk(amount="100.00", status="captured"):
    return Payment("pay_1", "inv_1", Decimal(amount), status=status, created_at=T0, captured_at=T0)

# partial then full
p = mk()
assert refund(p, "40.00", T0) is p
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("40.00") and p.status == "captured"
refund(p, "60.00", T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("100.00") and p.status == "refunded"

# over-refund rejected
p = mk()
refund(p, "60.00", T0)
try:
    refund(p, "50.00", T0); assert False
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured"

# non-captured rejected
p = mk(status="authorized")
try:
    refund(p, "10.00", T0); assert False
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "invalid_state"

# non-positive
p = mk()
try:
    refund(p, "0", T0); assert False
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "non_positive_amount"

# approval threshold
p = mk("1000.00")
try:
    refund(p, "500.01", T0); assert False
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "approval_required"
# exactly 500 no approval
p = mk("1000.00")
refund(p, "500.00", T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("500.00")
# above with approver
p = mk("1000.00")
refund(p, "500.01", T0, approved_by="mgr_1")
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("500.01")

# idempotency: same key returns same record, no double apply
audit.clear()
p = mk()
r1 = refund(p, "40.00", T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund(p, "40.00", T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is r2 is p
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("40.00")
evs = audit.events("payment_refunded")
assert len(evs) == 1 and evs[0]["idempotency_key"] == "k1"

# idempotency checked before state validation: retry after full refund
p = mk()
refund(p, "100.00", T0, idempotency_key="k2")
assert p.status == "refunded"
r = refund(p, "100.00", T0, idempotency_key="k2")
assert r is p and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("100.00")

# idempotency checked before approval validation
p = mk("1000.00")
refund(p, "600.00", T0, idempotency_key="k3", approved_by="mgr")
r = refund(p, "600.00", T0, idempotency_key="k3")  # no approver, but replay
assert r is p and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("600.00")

# callers without key still work
p = mk()
refund(p, "10.00", T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00")

print("ALL EDGE CASES PASSED")
EOF"}
